target.url: v1.1.0-rc.2 — the node SSR build of the scaffold from tree b0edaccedd7b, which `git rev-parse` shows is byte-identical to the tag's tree, served by `npx theokit start`

results.note: Root route against the released build with `ssr: true, ssrStreaming: true`: 15326 bytes, `<head>` open and close, `window.__staticRouterHydrationData` present, real markup inside `<div id="root">`, `</html>` present so the document is closed and parseable. One socket arrival at +13ms, which is correct for a route declaring no Suspense boundary — React emits the whole shell in a single flush when nothing suspends.

tests/unit/entry-server-web-execution.test.ts — 6 passed. The generated Web entry is imported and invoked with a real `Request`, returning a `Response` without throwing, which is what the criterion asks for in place of `toContain` over a template string.

Measured on a route declaring a Suspense boundary that resolves after 800ms, reading the raw TCP socket rather than a fetch body because fetch coalesces. THREE arrivals: +8ms carrying `<head>`, +811ms carrying the resolved content, +812ms carrying the hydration script. The first chunk carries `<head>` and arrives 800ms before the boundary resolves, so it is observably not the final buffered document — the case the criterion excludes by name. The measurement discriminates: the same probe against v1.1.0-rc.1 returned ONE arrival whose time tracked the delay (60ms -> 73ms, 800ms -> 815ms).
Each listed target exercised rather than declared: Web via the generated entry (6 passed), Tauri via packages/tauri (7 passed), TUI via packages/presenter (137 passed).

`grep -rlE 'renderToString|renderToPipeableStream|renderToReadableStream' packages/tauri/src` returns nothing, so there is no Tauri-specific renderer — the webview goes through the same pipeline. Suite: 7 passed.
packages/presenter: 12 files, 137 passed. The terminal presenter path is exercised, which is what the criterion asks for in place of an HTML document a terminal cannot have.
